command_templates.name: parse_hive
command_templates.when: When parsing the AppCompatCache from a SYSTEM hive.

usage_description: Parses the AppCompatCache (ShimCache) from the SYSTEM hive and outputs results to CSV files.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Execution of unknown or suspicious applications.
suspicious_indicators.description: Identifies potential execution of untrusted software.

suspicious_indicators.pattern: Timestamps indicating file copies rather than executions.
suspicious_indicators.description: May indicate the AppCompatCache timestamp is from a file copy operation, not an execution.

known_false_positives: Timestamps may reflect file copy operations instead of actual executions.
